question: Which untouched independent-group panel can support final action-bank confirmation without treating folds as new samples?

planning_basis.warning: These are opened-E3 planning approximations, not guarantees; K-fold repetition does not increase independent group count.

options.permitted_inference: candidate rejection or effect estimation after separately authorized locked analysis
options.forbidden_inference: positive final admission from this panel alone

options.powered_for_positive_admission: group count meets only the R4 65-group planning threshold, not the 136- or 607-group thresholds; the existing five-corruption H2 contract also fails the required 20-corruption coverage
options.permitted_inference: none until explicit authority and a separate final H2 protocol are frozen
options.forbidden_inference: any H2 image decode, model forward, truth read, or outcome analysis under the current readiness state

conclusion: E284 is scientifically useful but reject-only. H2 has enough groups for the R4-only primary hypothesis but its existing contract covers only five corruptions rather than the required 20 and it remains sealed; it cannot be used without explicit authority and a new action-bank-specific final protocol. No currently authorized panel supports positive final admission.
